moments.title: Robert Plant turns 78
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant celebrates his 78th birthday today, still lauded as one of rock's greatest voices.

angles.name: Rock God Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 78th to the golden god of rock, Robert Plant! Still got that unmistakable wail. What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

angles.name: Led Zeppelin Legacy
angles.copy: From 'Stairway to Heaven' to 'Whole Lotta Love', Robert Plant's voice defined an era. Celebrating the Led Zeppelin icon's 78th today!

moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday on Saturday, August 22nd, continuing her reign on the charts.

angles.name: Pop Queen Celebration
angles.copy: Get ready to 'Dance The Night Away'! Dua Lipa turns 31 this Saturday. What's your ultimate Dua Lipa anthem?

angles.name: Future Nostalgia Vibe
angles.copy: It's a big week for Dua Lipa! The 'New Rules' singer celebrates her 31st birthday on August 22nd. Let's get that 'Future Nostalgia' playlist on repeat.

moments.title: Creamfields 2026 kicks off
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest electronic dance music festival, Creamfields, takes over Daresbury, Cheshire, from August 27-30, featuring a massive lineup including Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, and Disclosure.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: 7 days until Creamfields 2026 bursts into life! Who are you most excited to see in Daresbury? 🎶

angles.name: Dance Music Mecca
angles.copy: The UK's dance music mecca is nearly here! Creamfields 2026 starts next Thursday, August 27th. Get ready for Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia & more!

moments.title: Shania Twain turns 61
moments.blurb: The 'Queen of Country Pop', Shania Twain, celebrates her 61st birthday on Thursday, August 28th, marking decades of iconic hits.

angles.name: Country Pop Icon
angles.copy: Let's go girls! Shania Twain turns 61 this Thursday. What's your favourite 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!' moment?

angles.name: Still The One
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Shania Twain on August 28th! Her hits still sound as fresh as ever. Which one are you singing today?

moments.title: Florence Welch turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence + The Machine's ethereal frontwoman, Florence Welch, celebrates her 40th birthday on Thursday, August 28th.

angles.name: Indie Queen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 40th to the magnificent Florence Welch! Her voice is pure magic. What's your favourite Florence + The Machine track?

angles.name: Machine Magic
angles.copy: The incredibly talented Florence Welch turns 40 this Thursday! From 'Dog Days Are Over' to 'Shake It Out', her music is timeless.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday approaches
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, providing a long weekend to end the summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: That glorious August Bank Holiday feeling is just around the corner! What are your plans for the long weekend? Fingers crossed for sunshine!

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: One last long weekend before autumn truly sets in! The Summer Bank Holiday is on Monday 31st August. How will you make the most of it?
